usageNotes: Creates a point-in-time snapshot of an LXC container; the container does not need to be stopped first, though a running container snapshot may have inconsistent filesystem state unless the application inside is quiesced. Returns a UPID string — poll the task API to confirm completion before relying on the snapshot. Requires the VM.Snapshot privilege on /vms/{vmid}.

examples.summary: Snapshot a running web-server container before a package upgrade

tips: snapname must follow pve-configid format: alphanumeric plus hyphens/underscores, max 40 chars — no spaces or dots.
Snapshots of running containers capture RAM state implicitly via the container's filesystem, but they are NOT crash-consistent; quiesce or stop the container for a clean backup.
Poll GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to wait for the snapshot task to finish before triggering any dependent operation (rollback, clone, etc.).
LXC snapshots require the storage backend to support snapshots (e.g., ZFS, LVM-thin, or Ceph); plain directory storage will fail at snapshot time.
